structure.unit: Coal Mining Property, Interests, Adjacent Owners, and Dams
Coal Mine Refuse Impoundments and Retaining Dams

text.section: On or before July 1 of each year, the operator of any retaining dam or mine refuse impoundment that meets the criteria of subsection A of § 45.2-618 shall submit to the Chief an emergency notification and evacuation plan. If there are no changes to a plan at the time the updated plan is due, the operator may submit a notice that there are no changes to the plan in lieu of submitting an updated plan to the Chief.
